'''2009 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 3–4 January 2009, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS16]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2009 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2009 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 3–4 January 2009
* '''Winner:''' —
